text: I think you'll really enjoy this recipe for The Best Chicken Rice Casserole. It features boneless skinless chicken breasts, which are a staple in your recipe reviews, and combines them with rice, cheese, and vegetables in a creamy casserole. The addition of garlic and chili powder gives it a flavorful kick that you tend to appreciate. The cooking time is a bit longer than your average recipe, but the end result is well worth it. I think you'll find this recipe satisfying and delicious.
